blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Telecommunications, cable and internet service providers in Cebu City may be required to remove abandoned wires, secure low-hanging cables, and respond to hazardous overhead lines within prescribed deadlines under a proposed ordinance aimed at making roads and sidewalks safer for residents. Filed by City Councilor Edgardo N. Labella II, the proposed Cebu City Overhead Wires Clean-Up Ordinance would require covered companies to identify and maintain their overhead lines, remove cables no longer in service, and ensure that active wires are properly tagged and secured.
